lines.say: At McMinn Law Firm, we know that after a crash, life gets complicated fast.
Doctor visits. Calls from the insurance company. Bills piling up.
We take the insurance company's calls.
We dig into what really happened.
And we fight for what you're owed.
So you can focus on getting your life back.
McMinn Law Firm. We've got it from here.

screen.head: After a crash, life gets **complicated** fast.
actions: We fight for what you’re owed.
